title: 2101. Detonate the Maximum Bombs

examples.explanation: The above figure shows the positions and ranges of the 2 bombs. If we detonate the left bomb, the right bomb will not be affected. But if we detonate the right bomb, both bombs will be detonated. So the maximum bombs that can be detonated is max(1, 2) = 2.
Detonating either bomb will not detonate the other bomb, so the maximum number of bombs that can be detonated is 1.

The best bomb to detonate is bomb 0 because: - Bomb 0 detonates bombs 1 and 2. The red circle denotes the range of bomb 0. - Bomb 2 detonates bomb 3. The blue circle denotes the range of bomb 2. - Bomb 3 detonates bomb 4. The green circle denotes the range of bomb 3. Thus all 5 bombs are detonated.

Bombs are nodes and are connected to other bombs in their range by directed edges.
If we know which bombs will be affected when any bomb is detonated, how can we find the total number of bombs that will be detonated if we start from a fixed bomb?
Run a Depth First Search (DFS) from every node, and all the nodes it reaches are the bombs that will be detonated.
